description: Narrow capability for pull-request windows, which show content strangers wrote. Their labels are derived from the pull request they show (see crates/specforge/src/pull_request_window.rs), so they are matched by glob. It grants exactly what the window uses: listening for the notices and snapshots it follows, closing itself on Escape or Cmd/Ctrl-W, and the application commands its root and view call — the provider flags and pull-request snapshots it resolves against, the detail, file and image reads, local review-progress operations, its checked link and zoom-window operations, its remembered-size setter, and the review-action commands of the desktop composer. It grants no settings, provider-writer, window-opening or document read command, and no dialog, autostart, notification, menu or tray permission (pull-request-actions: Application Commands Are Granted Per Window Kind; pull-request-viewer: Pull-Request Window Permissions).
